items.name: Test card
items.text: A test object the project made, not a visitor's: it checks a sleeve's picture, its ring of light, its tide and this card.

original.name: 测试卡片
original.text: 项目自己做的测试物件，不是访客的：用来检查薄板上的图、脚下的光圈、潮汐的光和这张卡片。

items.name: Test pebbles
items.text: Three pebbles drawn for testing: they check how stones are raised from a picture and stood beside the way.

original.name: 测试卵石
original.text: 画出来测试用的三块卵石：检查石头怎样从图片鼓成实体、立在路边。
